name: Pinecone
description: Version-pinned Pinecone vector indexes, namespaces, records, backups, collections and inference over bounded HTTPS REST.

permissions.description: Bounded HTTPS to fixed api.pinecone.io and configured public Pinecone index svc hostname; encrypted API key or RuntimeConnection credentials. Explicit confirmation for mutations/billed inference. Retries=0, no live verification or ambient credentials.

definitions.name: Pinecone Describe Index
definitions.documentation: Pinecone Describe Index. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Read request; pagination tokens are returned for caller-controlled continuation. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. definitions.name: Pinecone Describe Collection
definitions.documentation: Pinecone Describe Collection. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Read request; pagination tokens are returned for caller-controlled continuation. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. definitions.name: Pinecone Fetch Vectors
definitions.documentation: Pinecone Fetch Vectors. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Read request; pagination tokens are returned for caller-controlled continuation. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Read request; pagination tokens are returned for caller-controlled continuation. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. definitions.documentation: Pinecone List Imports. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Read request; pagination tokens are returned for caller-controlled continuation. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. definitions.name: Pinecone Describe Inference Model
definitions.documentation: Pinecone Describe Inference Model. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Read request; pagination tokens are returned for caller-controlled continuation. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. definitions.name: Pinecone List Indexes (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone List Indexes. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Read request; pagination tokens are returned for caller-controlled continuation. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.name: Pinecone Create Index (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Create Index. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=create-index; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.name: Pinecone Configure Index (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Configure Index. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=configure-index; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Delete Index. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=delete-index; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. definitions.name: Pinecone Create Integrated Embedding Index (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Create Integrated Embedding Index. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=create-model-index; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Delete Collection. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=delete-collection; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. definitions.name: Pinecone Create Backup (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Create Backup. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=create-backup; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.name: Pinecone Describe Index Statistics (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Describe Index Statistics. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Read request; pagination tokens are returned for caller-controlled continuation. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.name: Pinecone Query Vectors (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Query Vectors. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Read request; pagination tokens are returned for caller-controlled continuation. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.name: Pinecone Fetch Vectors By Metadata (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Fetch Vectors By Metadata. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Read request; pagination tokens are returned for caller-controlled continuation. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.name: Pinecone Upsert Vectors (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Upsert Vectors. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=upsert-vectors; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.name: Pinecone Update Vector (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Update Vector. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=update-vector; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.name: Pinecone Delete Vectors (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Delete Vectors. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=delete-vectors; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings. definitions.name: Pinecone Create Namespace (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Create Namespace. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=create-namespace; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.name: Pinecone Delete Namespace (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Delete Namespace. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=delete-namespace; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.name: Pinecone Search Integrated Records (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Search Integrated Records. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=search-records; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.documentation:
Pinecone List Inference Models. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Read request; pagination tokens are returned for caller-controlled continuation. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.name: Pinecone Generate Embeddings (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Generate Embeddings. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=embed; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview

definitions.name: Pinecone Rerank Documents (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pinecone Rerank Documents. Explicit X-Pinecone-Api-Version 2025-10: mature vector/integrated record indexes, not 2026-07 document-schema indexes. One bounded request/page, no polling or retries. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=rerank; this includes billed inference/search. Accepted writes, backup/import/restore statuses and eventually consistent counts do not prove completion. Reconcile uncertain results before a deliberate retry. Builtin $connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config.indexHost/apiKeySecret and credentials.apiKey (accessToken/password fallback), or use encrypted PINECONE_API_KEY/apiKeySecret. Control/inference origin is fixed api.pinecone.io; data origin requires a public *.svc[.region].pinecone.io index host. No redirects, custom proxies, private endpoints, ambient credentials, automatic host discovery, external import starts or 2026-07 document operations. Total timeout 100–30000 ms begins before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB, URL <=16384, lists bounded. JSON response unknown fields are projected away; optional absence and falsy values preserved. Counts accept safe integers or exact decimal strings; unsafe numeric count tokens fail rather than round. Metadata supports documented scalar/string-list values; filters support field comparisons plus one $and/$or level. Strict UTF-8 response decoding and UTF-16 strings.  No provider/deployed-worker verification. Pinecone and its marks belong to their owners; independent integration without endorsement. Sources: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_control_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/db_data_2025-10.oas.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-api/main/2025-10/inference_2025-10.oas.yaml https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/manage-data/target-an-index https://docs.pinecone.io/guides/index-data/indexing-overview
